authorization.request: 用户要求缩小 Desktop 更新确认命令字号，修复溢出并确保命令可复制；此前已授权通过 GitHub PR 更新商城。
authorization.publication: auditable-source-pull-request; separate Catalog policy release after source merge

objective: 改进 Desktop 更新确认弹窗：缩小命令与提示字号，提供可换行、点击即全选的只读命令框，并用短占位提示替代输入框中裁切的长命令；将修复作为 DSH Store 0.9.41 源码 PR 提交。

change.confirmationCommand: 10px monospace wrapping text container with click/focus select-all behavior
change.confirmationInput: 10px monospace input with short localized placeholder
change.instructionAndSpec: Reduce prompt and install-spec text to 10px and keep arbitrary wrapping

gates: Bind changes to the exact base Commit and precondition hashes; validate with scripts/verify-dsh-upgrade-plan.mjs
Run npm run check, node --check src/client.js, and git diff --check before source commit
Submit source changes through an auditable PR and preserve CI results as a separate gate
Create any Catalog pin only after the source Commit is fixed and the Catalog policy gate passes
rollback: Revert the source through a CI-checked pull request; the existing 0.9.40 Catalog pin remains authoritative until a separate policy release merges.
healthCheck: Plan verification, source syntax check, diff check, and source PR CI
